prayerExcerpt.en-US: Whoever loses his life for my sake will find it in eternity.
prayerExcerpt.pt-BR: Quem perde a sua vida por causa de mim vai encontrá-la.

meta.face: A lean man of about forty with a long, narrow, ascetic face — a narrow forehead, a thin, long, straight nose with a narrow bridge, large dark eyes under straight, dark, level brows, angular cheekbones over hollow cheeks, a narrow jaw and thin lips; a dark-brown moustache and a full dark-brown beard of medium length squared at the chin, and a steady, gentle gaze.
meta.basis: Follows the 1620s portrait drawing and the 1623 woodcut made soon after his death: a long, lean face with a full dark beard and moustache, the Byzantine crown-mitre and omophorion. He died at about forty-three.
